question: Road width (call C1). Streets are 17 m kerb to kerb; T1 shows about 10 m. The road is quantised to 8 m tiles (3 per street: 8 m lane tile + two kerb tiles holding 4.5 m of asphalt and the parked cars each), so a narrower street means re-cut kerb/junction tiles, the traffic lanes, the nav field and the parked-car slots, and moves replay and parity goldens. Which width should I build?

options.label: 10 m kerb to kerb (T1): 2 lanes, parked cars squeezed to a 1 m strip or onto the pavement
options.tradeoff: Matches T1 and tightens every chase and fight; vehicles lane's turning room and quest 1's car section get tight

options.label: 12 m kerb to kerb: 2 lanes + a 2 m parking lane on one side only
options.tradeoff: Keeps parked cars as cover and room to drive a hijacked car; reads between today and T1 (no mock yet, built on a yes)

options.label: Keep 17 m
options.tradeoff: No sim risk; street frames stay mostly asphalt at 48 px/m
